what it is for / what to preserve: First message when the customer says hello. {bank} is the bank's name.
en (English): Hello! I am {bank}'s virtual assistant. Ask me anything about our accounts, services, fees, or how to bank with us.
am (አማርኛ): ሰላም! እኔ የ{bank} ዲጂታል ረዳት ነኝ። ስለ ሂሳቦቻችን፣ አገልግሎቶቻችን፣ ክፍያዎች ወይም አጠቃቀም ማንኛውንም ጥያቄ ይጠይቁኝ።
om (Afaan Oromoo): Akkam! Ani gargaaraa dijitaalaa {bank} ti. Waa'ee herregaa, tajaajilaa, kaffaltii fi fayyadama keenyaa gaaffii kamiyyuu na gaafadhaa.
ti (ትግርኛ): ሰላም! ኣነ ናይ {bank} ዲጂታላዊ ሓጋዚ እየ። ብዛዕባ ሕሳባትና፣ ኣገልግሎታትና፣ ክፍሊታት ወይ ኣጠቓቕማ ዝኾነ ሕቶ ሕተቱኒ።
so (Soomaali): Salaan! Waxaan ahay kaaliyaha dijitaalka ah ee {bank}. Wax kasta oo ku saabsan xisaabaadka, adeegyada, khidmadaha iyo isticmaalka i weydii.

what it is for / what to preserve: Same, when the customer introduced themselves. {name} is what they called themselves — keep it natural to address someone by name here.
en (English): Hello {name}! I am {bank}'s virtual assistant. Ask me anything about our accounts, services, fees, or how to bank with us.
am (አማርኛ): ሰላም {name}! እኔ የ{bank} ዲጂታል ረዳት ነኝ። ስለ ሂሳቦቻችን፣ አገልግሎቶቻችን፣ ክፍያዎች ወይም አጠቃቀም ማንኛውንም ጥያቄ ይጠይቁኝ።
om (Afaan Oromoo): Akkam {name}! Ani gargaaraa dijitaalaa {bank} dha. Waa'ee herregaa, tajaajilaa, kaffaltii yookaan itti fayyadama gaafadhaa.
ti (ትግርኛ): ሰላም {name}! ኣነ ናይ {bank} ዲጂታላዊ ሓጋዚ እየ። ብዛዕባ ሕሳባትና፣ ኣገልግሎትና፣ ክፍሊት ወይ ኣጠቓቕማ ዝኾነ ሕቶ ሕተቱኒ።
so (Soomaali): Salaan {name}! Waxaan ahay kaaliyaha dijitaalka ah ee {bank}. Wax walba oo ku saabsan xisaabaha, adeegyada, khidmadaha ama isticmaalka i weydii.

what it is for / what to preserve: A FRAGMENT, not a sentence. Another full sentence is joined onto the end of it, so it must read as an opening, e.g. 'Thanks Oli —'. Keep whatever punctuation makes that work in your language.
Said when the bank's own documents do not answer the question. It must admit not knowing without sounding like a failure — the honesty is the product's selling point. Never imply an answer was given.
en (English): I don't have verified information about that yet, so I won't guess. I've noted your question for our customer service team — they can follow up with you.
am (አማርኛ): ስለዚህ ጉዳይ የተረጋገጠ መረጃ ስለሌለኝ መገመት አልፈልግም። ጥያቄዎን ለደንበኞች አገልግሎት ቡድናችን አስተላልፌዋለሁ — በቅርቡ ያገኙዎታል።
om (Afaan Oromoo): Waa'ee kanaa odeeffannoo mirkanaa'e waan hin qabneef tilmaamuu hin barbaadu. Gaaffii keessan garee tajaajila maamiltootaa keenyaaf dabarseera — dhiyootti isin qunnamu.
ti (ትግርኛ): ብዛዕባ እዚ ዝተረጋገጸ ሓበሬታ ስለ ዘይብለይ ክግምት ኣይደልን። ሕቶኹም ናብ ጉጅለ ኣገልግሎት ዓማዊልና ኣመሓላሊፈዮ ኣለኹ — ኣብ ቀረባ ግዜ ክረኽቡኹም እዮም።
so (Soomaali): Arrintan macluumaad la xaqiijiyey kama hayo, mana doonayo inaan qiyaaso. Su'aashaada waxaan u gudbiyey kooxda adeegga macaamiisha — dhawaan way kula soo xiriiri doonaan.

what it is for / what to preserve: Appended to an answer drawn from universal banking knowledge rather than this bank's material. It must be unmistakable that the bank is NOT the source, or the bank is on the hook for something it never published.
en (English): General guidance — this is standard banking practice, not {bank}'s own published information. Please check with {bank} for anything specific to your account.
am (አማርኛ): አጠቃላይ መመሪያ — ይህ የተለመደ የባንክ አሠራር እንጂ የ{bank} ይፋዊ መረጃ አይደለም። ከሂሳብዎ ጋር ለተያያዘ ማንኛውም ጉዳይ {bank}ን ያማክሩ።
om (Afaan Oromoo): Qajeelfama waliigalaa — kun hojimaata baankii idilee malee odeeffannoo ifaa {bank} miti. Waan herrega keessan ilaallatu kamiyyuu {bank} gaafadhaa.
ti (ትግርኛ): ሓፈሻዊ መምርሒ — እዚ ልሙድ ናይ ባንክ ኣሰራርሓ እምበር ወግዓዊ ሓበሬታ {bank} ኣይኮነን። ምስ ሕሳብኩም ዝተኣሳሰር ዝኾነ ነገር {bank} ሕተቱ።
so (Soomaali): Hagaajin guud — kani waa hab-dhaqanka caadiga ah ee bangiyada, ma aha macluumaadka rasmiga ah ee {bank}. Wax kasta oo la xiriira xisaabtaada la xaqiiji {bank}.

what it is for / what to preserve: Introduces a bulleted list of topic titles that follows immediately. MUST be a statement, never a question — it used to ask 'were you asking about one of these?', which competed with the contact request below it and meant customers answered the wrong question. Ends with a colon.
en (English): In the meantime, these related topics may help:
am (አማርኛ): እስከዚያው ድረስ፣ እነዚህ ተዛማጅ ርዕሶች ሊረዱዎት ይችላሉ፦
om (Afaan Oromoo): Hanga sanaatti, mata dureewwan walqabatan kunneen isin gargaaruu danda'u:
ti (ትግርኛ): ኣብ መንጎኡ፡ እዞም ተዛመድቲ ኣርእስትታት ክሕግዙኹም ይኽእሉ፦
so (Soomaali): Inta u dhaxaysa, mawduucyada la xiriira ee hoos ku qoran ayaa laga yaabaa inay ku caawiyaan:

what it is for / what to preserve: The one question the turn is for. It is always the LAST thing in the message, so it must work as a closing line. Asks for a name and a phone number; an email is also accepted if the customer gives one.
en (English): So a person from our team can get back to you, may I have your name and the best phone number to reach you on?
am (አማርኛ): ከቡድናችን አንድ ሰው እንዲያገኝዎት፣ ስምዎን እና የሚደረስብዎትን የስልክ ቁጥር ሊነግሩኝ ይችላሉ?
om (Afaan Oromoo): Namni garee keenyaa akka isin qunnamuuf, maqaa keessanii fi lakkoofsa bilbilaa ittiin isin argannu naaf kennuu dandeessuu?
ti (ትግርኛ): ሓደ ኣባል ጋንታና ክረኽበኩም ምእንቲ፡ ስምኩምን እትርከቡሉ ቁጽሪ ተሌፎንን ክትህቡኒ ትኽእሉ ዶ?
so (Soomaali): Si qof ka mid ah kooxdayadu ay kuula soo xiriiraan, ma i siin kartaa magacaaga iyo lambarka telefoonka ee lagugu heli karo?

what it is for / what to preserve: Said INSTEAD of asking again, when we already have their number. Its own short sentence on its own line. {contact} is their phone number or email.
Confirms their details were stored. {contact} is what they gave.
en (English): Thank you — I've passed your details to our customer service team. They will contact you on {contact}.
am (አማርኛ): አመሰግናለሁ — መረጃዎን ለደንበኞች አገልግሎት ቡድናችን አስተላልፌያለሁ። በ{contact} ያገኙዎታል።
om (Afaan Oromoo): Galatoomaa — odeeffannoo keessan gara garee tajaajila maamiltootaa keenyaatti dabarseera. Lakkoofsa {contact} irratti isin qunnamu.
ti (ትግርኛ): የቐንየለይ — ሓበሬታኹም ናብ ጋንታ ኣገልግሎት ዓማዊልና ኣመሓላሊፈዮ ኣለኹ። ብ{contact} ክረኽቡኹም እዮም።
so (Soomaali): Mahadsanid — macluumaadkaaga waxaan u gudbiyay kooxda adeegga macaamiisha. Waxay kugula soo xiriiri doonaan {contact}.

what it is for / what to preserve: Same, when we also captured their name.
en (English): Thank you {name} — I've passed your details to our customer service team. They will contact you on {contact}.
am (አማርኛ): አመሰግናለሁ {name} — መረጃዎን ለደንበኞች አገልግሎት ቡድናችን አስተላልፌያለሁ። በ{contact} ያገኙዎታል።
om (Afaan Oromoo): Galatoomaa {name} — odeeffannoo keessan gara garee tajaajila maamiltootaa keenyaatti dabarseera. Lakkoofsa {contact} irratti isin qunnamu.
ti (ትግርኛ): የቐንየለይ {name} — ሓበሬታኹም ናብ ጋንታ ኣገልግሎት ዓማዊልና ኣመሓላሊፈዮ ኣለኹ። ብ{contact} ክረኽቡኹም እዮም።
so (Soomaali): Mahadsanid {name} — macluumaadkaaga waxaan u gudbiyay kooxda adeegga macaamiisha. Waxay kugula soo xiriiri doonaan {contact}.

what it is for / what to preserve: A security refusal: the assistant cannot see anyone's account. It must be firm but not accusing — most people asking are legitimate customers who simply expected it to work. Ends by offering general help.
en (English): For your security, I can't access individual account details in this chat. Please use the mobile banking app, visit a branch, or contact customer care. Is there anything general I can help you with?
am (አማርኛ): ለደህንነትዎ ሲባል በዚህ ውይይት ውስጥ የግል ሂሳብ መረጃ ማየት አልችልም። እባክዎ የሞባይል ባንኪንግ መተግበሪያውን ይጠቀሙ፣ ቅርንጫፍ ይጎብኙ ወይም የደንበኞች አገልግሎት ያነጋግሩ። በአጠቃላይ ጉዳይ ልርዳዎት?
om (Afaan Oromoo): Nageenya keessaniif, marii kana keessatti odeeffannoo herrega dhuunfaa arguu hin danda'u. Maaloo appii baankii mobaayilaa fayyadamaa, damee daawwadhaa yookiin tajaajila maamiltootaa qunnamaa.
ti (ትግርኛ): ንድሕነትኩም፣ ኣብዚ ዝርርብ ናይ ውልቂ ሕሳብ ሓበሬታ ክርኢ ኣይክእልን። በጃኹም ናይ ሞባይል ባንኪ መተግበሪ ተጠቐሙ፣ ጨንፈር ብጽሑ ወይ ንኣገልግሎት ዓማዊል ርኸቡ።
so (Soomaali): Amnigaaga awgiis, wadahadalkan kuma eegi karo macluumaadka xisaabta gaarka ah. Fadlan isticmaal abka bangiga mobilada, booqo laan ama la xiriir adeegga macaamiisha.

what it is for / what to preserve: For a customer reporting something wrong — theft, a failed transfer, bad service. Sympathy first, then the promise that a person will follow up.
en (English): I'm sorry you've had this experience. I've flagged your message for our customer service team so a person can follow up with you.
am (አማርኛ): ስለደረሰብዎት ችግር ይቅርታ እንጠይቃለን። መልዕክትዎን ለደንበኞች አገልግሎት ቡድናችን አስተላልፌዋለሁ — አንድ ሰው በቅርቡ ያገኙዎታል።
om (Afaan Oromoo): Rakkoo isin mudateef dhiifama gaafanna. Ergaa keessan garee tajaajila maamiltootaaf dabarseera — namni tokko dhiyootti isin qunnama.
ti (ትግርኛ): ብዘጋጠመኩም ጸገም ይቕሬታ ንሓትት። መልእኽትኹም ናብ ጉጅለ ኣገልግሎት ዓማዊል ኣመሓላሊፈዮ ኣለኹ — ሓደ ሰብ ኣብ ቀረባ ግዜ ክረኽበኩም እዩ።
so (Soomaali): Waan ka xunnahay dhibaatada kaa soo gaartay. Fariintaada waxaan u gudbiyey kooxda adeegga macaamiisha — qof ayaa dhawaan kula soo xiriiri doona.

what it is for / what to preserve: For a customer who asked to speak to a person, when NOBODY is on duty to take the call. NOT a refusal — the request is being granted, just not this second. It must say plainly that no one is free right now: an earlier version implied a person was standing by, the customer waited for a call that could not come, and that is the failure this wording exists to prevent. Warm and brief; the contact request follows it.
en (English): Of course. Nobody from our team is free to talk right now, so I've passed your request to customer service and a person will follow up with you.
am (አማርኛ): እሺ። አሁን ከቡድናችን ውስጥ በቀጥታ ሊያናግርዎት የሚችል ሰው የለም፤ ስለዚህ ጥያቄዎን ወደ ደንበኞች አገልግሎት አስተላልፌዋለሁ እና አንድ ሰው ያገኝዎታል።
om (Afaan Oromoo): Tole. Amma garee keenya keessaa namni kallattiin isin dubbisuu danda'u hin jiru, kanaaf gaaffii keessan gara tajaajila maamiltootaatti dabarseera, namni tokkos isin qunnama.
ti (ትግርኛ): ሕራይ። ሕጂ ካብ ጉጅለና ብቐጥታ ክዛረበኩም ዝኽእል ሰብ የለን፡ ስለዚ ሕቶኹም ናብ ኣገልግሎት ዓማዊል ኣመሓላሊፈዮ ኣለኹ፡ ሓደ ሰብ ድማ ክረኽበኩም እዩ።
so (Soomaali): Waa hagaag. Hadda ma jiro qof kooxdayada ka mid ah oo toos kuula hadli kara, sidaas darteed codsigaaga waxaan u gudbiyey adeegga macaamiisha, qofna wuu kula soo xiriiri doonaa.

what it is for / what to preserve: The same request, when a banker IS on duty and the chat is about to show a card with a Connect button on it. Keep the word 'Connect' in Latin script exactly as written — it is the label printed on the button, which is not translated, and a customer told to press a word they cannot find on screen is worse off than one told nothing. No contact details are asked for after this one: the button IS the answer.
en (English): Of course — a banker is available right now. Use the Connect button just below to start a secure session with them.
am (አማርኛ): እሺ — አሁን ዝግጁ የሆነ ባንከር አለ። ከእሱ ጋር ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ክፍለ ጊዜ ለመጀመር ከታች ያለውን «Connect» የሚለውን ቁልፍ ይጠቀሙ።
om (Afaan Oromoo): Tole — amma baankariin qophaa'e jira. Isaan waliin marii nagaa qabu jalqabuuf, qabduu «Connect» jedhu kan gadii kana fayyadamaa.
ti (ትግርኛ): ሕራይ — ሕጂ ድሉው ዝኾነ ባንከር ኣሎ። ምስኡ ውሑስ ክፍለ-ግዜ ንምጅማር ኣብ ታሕቲ ዘሎ «Connect» ዝብል መልጎም ተጠቐሙ።
so (Soomaali): Waa hagaag — hadda waxaa diyaar ah bangi-shaqaale. Isticmaal badhanka «Connect» ee hoosta ku yaal si aad kulan ammaan ah ula bilowdo.
